name: Twitter bird
note: Verified Simple Icons release 9.0.0. Original 2012–2023 bird geometry, filled blue #1DA1F2 here. Simple Icons released under CC0; brand trademark remains.

name: Facebook old wordmark
note: 2005–2015 Facebook wordmark. Commons PD-textlogo, trademark noted. Derivative isolates original letter paths and colors them blue; removes blue backing rectangle and tiny registered-mark path.

name: YouTube old wordmark
note: Old YouTube logotype with red Tube enclosure, 3 paths. Commons PD-textlogo, trademark noted. Red enclosure uses knockout letter holes; works as extrusion, with pale backing needed for white Tube letters.

name: Yahoo old Y!
note: Older 2009–2013 serif Y! icon. Commons PD-shape, trademark noted. Raw icon includes oval around Y; derivative removes oval and preserves original Y and exclamation mark paths, colored purple.

name: HP 2012
note: 2012 original blue round HP mark, sourced by Commons from HP materials. Commons PD-textlogo, trademark noted. Also supplied simple-icons 9.0.0 compact single-path equivalent hp.svg, CC0.
